exposure: Birth experience (type of delivery, pain, staff support)
outcome: Fear of childbirth (FOC) before and after delivery
finding: While fear of childbirth decreased after delivery overall, women with high initial fear and those who experienced instrumental vaginal delivery, emergency cesarean section, high pain, or low staff support during labor maintained higher levels of FOC postpartum.
mod_finding: Instrumental vaginal delivery and emergency cesarean section were associated with higher levels of FOC after delivery.
